subject: Coord: EU DPO + APAC security oncall windows for private deployment walkthrough
messages:
From: Sophie Dupont <sophie.dupont@orbital-health.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-19T08:12:00Z
Subject: Private deployment security walkthrough — EU DPO + APAC security leads

Hi Connor / Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for coordinating. Orbital Health is preparing for a Dedicated/Private deployment evaluation and our EU DPO (me) will need a focused security walkthrough ahead of procurement. We also need the APAC security lead (Kenji) to review site isolation, key management integration, and audit logs for our Japan region.

Constraints: EU team prefers mornings in CEST; APAC prefers late-morning JST. We are mindful of DST transitions in Europe next week, so please include explicit timezones in invites (CEST vs UTC).

Would you be able to propose 2 short sessions (30–45m): one EU-focused and one APAC-focused, ideally both next week? I attached a short SOC2 summary and a list of documents we expect.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Sophie Dupont
EU Data Protection Officer
Orbital Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Dupont <sophie.dupont@orbital-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment security walkthrough — EU DPO + APAC security leads

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the SOC2 summary.

We can run two focused sessions next week. Proposed slots (times shown in local zone + UTC for clarity):
- EU session: Tue Apr 26, 09:00 CEST (07:00 UTC) — 45m — agenda: data flows, KMS/HSM options, audit log retention
- APAC session: Wed Apr 28, 10:00 JST (01:00 UTC) — 45m — agenda: VPC/on-prem connectivity, regional key management, regional audit/access controls

If those don't land, I attached a small ICS with a few alternatives across late-afternoon EU / early-morning APAC windows. Note: CEST begins for many EU offices on Apr 25 (DST), so I flagged CEST explicitly in invites.

Action: can Marissa or Karthik confirm internal attendees and any pre-read? Sophie / Kenji — can you confirm these two slots or propose alternatives?

Attachments: calendar-options.ics

Best,
Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Connor / Sophie — happy to run both sessions. Quick notes:
- I suggest two concrete agendas (30m technical, 15m Q&A) so we respect DPO time.
- Internal attendees: Connor (runtime/KMS), Karthik (network/VPC), Laura (privacy & compliance).
- I'll prepare a 1-page pre-read + export of recent audit-log examples.

Kenji — can you confirm whether Apr 28 JST 10:00 works? Sophie noted your team may have limited availability around Apr 24–27.

Attaching the stakeholder list so legal knows who will receive artifacts.

Attachments: stakeholder-list.csv

Cheers,
Marissa
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — that plan is good. Quick confirms:
- EU session: Tue Apr 26, 09:00 CEST (works for my calendar). Please keep it tight (35–40m).
- APAC session: Apr 28 is preferable for our Japan reviewers — I can do Apr 28 afternoon CEST if needed but prefer not to do late evenings.

One note on documents: please include the last 90-day audit log extracts and the proposed KMS key rotation policy draft.

I will loop Kenji directly.

Best,

EU DPO
Orbital Health
